messages:
nina: Quick follow-up from the token rotation postmortem. Root cause: race between secret-rotation job and validator cache eviction. Resulted in ~2m of 401s and ~20s of dropped audit events during consumer rebalance. Need owners and a short remediation plan.
sam: Thanks. Minimal repro or steps?
nina: Sequence: secret-rotation job updates KVS -> validators restart -> cached claims still used by gateway because cache invalidation depends on validator health ping which lagged. Audit shipper experienced consumer rebalance during peak and dropped a small window. Repro steps in incident doc: https://internal.redwood.com/ops/incident/2280501234
tara: I can own a two-part fix: (1) make rotation atomic on KVS so validators read new secret after checkpoint, (2) add immediate cache flush hook post-rotation. Small PR, feature-flagged. ETA: Wed EOD.
sam: I'll add defensive behavior on the gateway: on 401, force a synchronous validation call (with a short timeout) before serving. Also add unit + integration test that simulates rotation during calls. ETA: next Tue.
infra-sre: I'll harden the audit shipper consumer: increase min fetch bytes, add local buffering for 60s and idempotent retry to the sink. Also create a temporary auto-throttle for rotation jobs if consumer lag spikes. ETA: tomorrow morning.
nina: Good. Let's capture action items: 
- [ ] TARA: atomic rotation + cache-flush hook, PR link when available
- [ ] SAM: gateway revalidate-on-401 + tests
- [ ] INFRA-SRE: audit shipper buffer + throttle rule
- [ ] NINA: update incident runbook with emergency rollback for rotations and an example curl for manual token refresh

nina: Example manual test for oncall: 
`curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROTATED_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.com/v1/health`
If 401, run: `scripts/force-refresh-tokens --service gateway --dry-run` then escalate.

tara: PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/runtime/pulls/1533 - includes feature flag `auth.rotation_atomic_v1`. Needs reviews from @sam and @infra-sre.
sam: Added test harness PR: https://git.redwood.com/gateway/pulls/77 - revalidate-on-401 and a deploy-order e2e. Requesting review from @tara.
infra-sre: Infra PR: https://git.redwood.com/infra/pulls/842 - local buffer + retry + consumer-lag alert (kafka.consumer.lag > 3000 -> page). Added temporary throttling: rotation jobs limited to 1 concurrent per region.
remediation-bot: Created SEC-3011: "token-rotation-cache-race" and linked SRV-4402. Watchers: nina, sam, tara, infra-sre. Status: in_progress.
nina: Scheduling 20m handoff tomorrow 11:00 PST to review rollout and rollback steps. Please bring smoke tests and metrics.
sam: I'll bring the test traces and a kill-switch flag for revalidation.
tara: I'll bring the PR diff and a script to force cache flush.
infra-sre: I'll bring consumer lag dashboards and the throttle config.
nina: Final ask: run a weekly consumer-lag check for 3 weeks and post results to the ticket. If anyone needs an extension on ETA, flag it in SEC-3011. :thumbsup:
sam: ack
tara: ack
infra-sre: ack
remediation-bot: SEC-3011 updated: committers assigned, due date in 7 days.
